prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A group of young people, all dressed in matching dark athletic tracksuits and white sneakers, are lined up outdoors on a sandy ground, performing push-ups in unison. The camera is positioned low to the ground at a dramatic side angle, emphasizing the repetition and discipline of the group as their bodies form a rhythmic diagonal line receding into the distance. Their heads are bowed in concentration, faces partially obscured, conveying a sense of effort and determination. The background features a soft, natural landscape with a gentle slope of a green hill, some trees, and a pale, overcast sky, lending a subdued and contemplative mood to the scene. The color palette is muted, dominated by deep blues, grays, and earthy tones, with the white shoes providing stark contrast. The lighting is natural and diffused, with no harsh shadows, enhancing the realism and somber atmosphere. The overall style is cinematic and immersive, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the foreground figures while softly blurring the background, evoking a sense of discipline, endurance, and unity.
